title: New version
content: I dream of small world frequently and more recently a lot about an underground event happening. I’m more part of the resistance lately. I hope that doesn’t cause any trouble in the comments, but will explain if someone ask. I recently had a dream that felt like my world today, but it was me in a trailer park and I’ve had this dream before a couple of times. Recently every time I go to the trailer home And I play old records on a Vynal record player and sometimes it’s been the same records over and over like the Beatles and music from the 50s also and every time I leave, I can’t get out and have seen the same faces in this stream. I’m wondering if anybody has experienced this before but it’s like a trailer park with no endand always going to play these records on the Vynal.
